messages:
Alex: Quick check — planning to cut v1.12.0 today. Need coordinated bumps across api, runtime, console, and SDK. Target cutoff 18:00 PT. Any last-minute breaking changes or rollout constraints?
Sam: Heads up — runtime has a config rename (kv_cache.enabled -> cache.kv_enabled) that will break older SDKs unless we pin compatibility. I can make a shim, but that pushes SDK bump to a minor instead of patch.
Lior: @Sam thanks. Do we have a changelog blurb for the rename? We should mention migration steps for customers.
Sam: I'll add a short note. Proposed text: "runtime: config rename kv_cache.enabled -> cache.kv_enabled (SDKs <1.11 require shim)." Keep it terse.
Ivan: API repo is green, PR #2345 is the version bump (api -> 1.12.0). Console needs a small UX tweak for the version selector — ConsoleOncall is on it and will merge before cutoff.
ConsoleOncall: console PR created: #678. It updates the dropdown and pins SDK compatibility matrix. ETA merge 17:20 PT.
ReleaseBot: auto-check: SDK repo missing release tag for 1.12.0, runtime PR references api#2345 but not console. Please ensure cross-repo PR descriptions include related PRs.
Alex: Good call ReleaseBot. Action items: (1) @Sam add the changelog + shim PR for SDKs; (2) @ConsoleOncall merge console #678; (3) @Ivan confirm api tag pushed; (4) create release PR in release repo that references api#2345 runtime#901 console#678 sdk#112. Use label `release/bump`.
Lior: One more: if runtime needs a major for the rename, do we want to backport a compatibility shim into 1.12.x or schedule 2.0? Prefer shim now for minimal customer impact.
Sam: Agreed — I'll ship a lightweight shim and a proper 2.0 plan. Shim PR: sdk#112, includes test that reads both keys. Example snippet in PR:```python
# runtime accepts both legacy and new keys
cfg_cache = cfg.get("cache", {})
kv_flag = cfg_cache.get("kv_enabled", cfg.get("kv_cache", {}).get("enabled"))
```
Ivan: I'll push the api tag after console merge. Will ping here when done.
ConsoleOncall: merged and deployed to staging. Quick smoke looks good. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks everyone. If you hit any last-minute blockers post-merge, ping `#eng-oncall` and I'll coordinate rollback plan. I'll open the final release PR at 17:45 PT.
ReleaseBot: release PR template created at release#45 (draft). Remember to attach the changelog artifact.
Alex: Perfect — closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
